title: Centenarians per 100,000 people

source.name: Japan Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare centenarian count (95,119 as of Sept 1 2024) and U.S. Census Bureau centenarian estimate (101,000, 2024), divided by each country's total population

notes: Rate computed from official centenarian counts divided by each country's total population (Japan ~123.9M, US ~335M) and scaled per 100,000 residents.
